Sridevi Reddy

Certified Scrum Master I Senior Business Analyst +91-9346425154 | Sridevi.sr24@gmail.com | Bengaluru

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Certified Scrum Master and Business Analyst with 11 years of IT experience across US Healthcare Payer

and Life Insurance. Strong experience in requirements elicitation, discovery workshops, process

analysis, BRD/FRD, functional specifications, user stories, acceptance criteria, data mapping,

integrations and UAT.

Experienced in Agile/Scrum delivery, facilitating sprint ceremonies, backlog refinement, sprint/release

planning, impediment and dependency management, Agile metrics and continuous improvement.

Strong stakeholder collaboration with Product Owners, IT, architects, developers, QA, vendors and

business teams to drive effective SDLC delivery.

SKILLS & TOOLS

Sprint Planning

Business Analysis

Agile / Scrum

Requirements Elicitation & Stakeholder Management

BRD / FRD / User Stories / Acceptance Criteria

Process Mapping & Gap Analysis

Project Planning, Tracking & Delivery

Risk, Issue & Dependency Management

Cross-Functional Team Leadership

Backlog Refinement & Sprint Planning

UAT & Quality Assurance

Release & Go-Live Management

UI/UX Collaboration & Wireframing

SDLC



Jira / Confluence / Trello

Figma / Balsamiq / MS Visio

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Business Analyst Cum Scrum Master | Cloudbridge Tech LLP

Feb 2025 – Present

Project: US Healthcare RCM & Claims Management Platform

Client: RCxRules

Project Overview

Worked on a US Healthcare Revenue Cycle Management and Claims Management platform designed

to streamline the end-to-end claims and payment lifecycle, from patient/member eligibility and claim

submission through adjudication, denial management, payment and reconciliation.

The platform integrated with providers, payer systems, clearinghouses and downstream payment

systems to improve claims processing accuracy, reduce denials, and provide better visibility into

outstanding claims and reimbursement.

Responsibilities:

Facilitated discovery and requirement workshops with Claims, Operations, Provider, Member

Services, Clinical and Compliance stakeholders to understand current-state RCM workflows

and define future-state requirements. Performed requirements elicitation, process analysis,

gap analysis and impact analysis, translating business needs into functional specifications,

process flows and actionable user stories. Created and maintained BRDs, FRDs, user stories,

acceptance criteria, business rules, data mapping and integration requirements across the

claims and reimbursement lifecycle.

Worked on EDI X12 834, 835 and 837 transactions, supporting healthcare enrolment, claims

payment/remittance, and claims submission processes.

Performed EDI transaction validation, mapping, testing and issue analysis for 834/835/837 files, ensuring accurate data exchange between payer, provider and trading partners. • Collaborated with Product Owners, architects, developers, QA and vendors to clarify

requirements, validate solutions and ensure alignment with business and technical objectives.

Managed and refined epics, features and product backlog, prioritizing requirements based on

business value, dependencies, risks and release priorities.

Facilitated Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Backlog Refinement, Sprint Reviews and

Retrospectives, ensuring effective Agile delivery and team collaboration. Supported sprint and

release planning based on product priorities, team capacity, dependencies and timelines while

ensuring stories met DoR and DoD.

Proactively managed risks, impediments, blockers, issues and cross-team dependencies,

driving resolution and maintaining stakeholder communication. Coordinated UAT, defect

triage, business validation and production readiness, working closely with QA, development

and business teams through release.

Hands-on Scrum Master experience managing sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog

refinement, sprint reviews, retrospectives, impediment resolution, and coordinating delivery

across BA, development and QA teams.

Hands-on US Healthcare application experience working with payer/provider workflows, claims processing, enrollment and eligibility, including analysis and validation of healthcare application requirements and EDI 834/835/837 transactions.

Tracked velocity, burndown/burnup and sprint health, maintained Azure DevOps/Jira

artifacts, facilitated continuous improvement and ensured successful delivery of RCM

enhancements.

Business Analyst Cum Scrum Master | Sygnius Infotech

Feb 2021 - Dec 2024

Project: US Healthcare Provider Credentialing & Network Management Platform

Client: Verisys

Project Overview

Worked on a healthcare payer platform for provider onboarding, credentialing, network participation

and provider lifecycle management. The platform streamlined provider data collection, credential

verification, network enrollment, contract management and ongoing provider maintenance.

Responsibilities:

Conducted stakeholder workshops and requirement discussions with business, Operations,

Provider, Member Services and Compliance teams to understand healthcare workflows and

define business requirements.

Hands-on experience with HL7 healthcare integration, working with HL7 messages/interfaces

to support secure and accurate exchange of clinical and administrative healthcare data

between payer, provider, EHR/EMR, and other healthcare applications. Involved in

understanding interface requirements, validating message formats/data, analyzing integration

issues, and coordinating with technical teams to ensure successful end-to-end healthcare data

flow.

Analyzed current-state processes, business pain points and functional gaps, and designed

future-state workflows to improve operational efficiency and claims processing.

Translated requirements into epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, functional

specifications and process flows, ensuring requirements were clear and testable.

Worked with Product Owners, architects, developers and QA teams to evaluate solution

options, system integrations, business rules and data requirements.

• Managed and prioritized the product backlog, supporting requirement decomposition, story

refinement, dependency identification and sprint readiness.

Facilitated Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Backlog Refinement, Sprint Reviews and

Retrospectives, ensuring effective Scrum adoption and delivery cadence.

Coordinated with cross-functional teams to manage risks, blockers, impediments,

dependencies and action items, proactively resolving issues affecting sprint commitments.

Supported UAT planning and execution, including business scenario validation, defect triage,

requirement clarification, retesting and stakeholder sign-off.

Coordinated release planning, production readiness and deployment activities, ensuring scope,

documentation and business validation were completed before release.

Monitored sprint velocity, burndown, delivery progress and team capacity, communicated

status and risks to stakeholders, and drove continuous improvement through retrospective

actions.

Functional Test Engineer | Infiride Technologies Ltd

Oct 2015 - Feb 2021

Responsibilities:

Create detailed test cases based on business and functional requirements.

Execute functional, regression, and integration test cases to ensure application behavior

matches requirements.



Identify, document, and report defects using defect management tools (e.g., JIRA).

Maintain clear and thorough documentation of test cases, test results, and defect reports.

Perform regression testing to ensure new changes do not negatively impact existing

functionality.

Work closely with developers to reproduce issues and verify fixes.

Collaborate with business analysts and product managers to review functional requirements

and provide feedback.

Verify the functionality and usability of the application’s user interface.

Configure and set up test environments that simulate real-world scenarios.

Perform testing across different platforms (e.g., web, mobile) and browsers to ensure

consistent functionality.

Provide regular updates on test progress, results, and any issues identified during testing.

EDUCATION

B.Sc. - Computer Science - William Carey University, 2009, 72.3%

LICENSES AND CERTIFICATIONS

Scrum Master Certified (SMC) - Scrum Alliance

Issued: 11/10/2024, Expires: 11/10/2026

Credential ID: 2015212

URL: https://bcert.me/skmjpxnam

sections.label: Experience
sections.text:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Business Analyst Cum Scrum Master | Cloudbridge Tech LLP
Feb 2025 – Present
Project: US Healthcare RCM & Claims Management Platform
Client: RCxRules
Project Overview
Worked on a US Healthcare Revenue Cycle Management and Claims Management platform designed
to streamline the end-to-end claims and payment lifecycle, from patient/member eligibility and claim
submission through adjudication, denial management, payment and reconciliation.
The platform integrated with providers, payer systems, clearinghouses and downstream payment
systems to improve claims processing accuracy, reduce denials, and provide better visibility into
outstanding claims and reimbursement.
Responsibilities:
Facilitated discovery and requirement workshops with Claims, Operations, Provider, Member
Services, Clinical and Compliance stakeholders to understand current-state RCM workflows
and define future-state requirements. Performed requirements elicitation, process analysis,
gap analysis and impact analysis, translating business needs into functional specifications,
process flows and actionable user stories. Created and maintained BRDs, FRDs, user stories,
acceptance criteria, business rules, data mapping and integration requirements across the
claims and reimbursement lifecycle.
Worked on EDI X12 834, 835 and 837 transactions, supporting healthcare enrolment, claims
payment/remittance, and claims submission processes.
Performed EDI transaction validation, mapping, testing and issue analysis for 834/835/837 files, ensuring accurate data exchange between payer, provider and trading partners. • Collaborated with Product Owners, architects, developers, QA and vendors to clarify
requirements, validate solutions and ensure alignment with business and technical objectives.
Managed and refined epics, features and product backlog, prioritizing requirements based on
business value, dependencies, risks and release priorities.
Facilitated Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Backlog Refinement, Sprint Reviews and
Retrospectives, ensuring effective Agile delivery and team collaboration. Supported sprint and
release planning based on product priorities, team capacity, dependencies and timelines while
ensuring stories met DoR and DoD.
Proactively managed risks, impediments, blockers, issues and cross-team dependencies,
driving resolution and maintaining stakeholder communication. Coordinated UAT, defect
triage, business validation and production readiness, working closely with QA, development
and business teams through release.
Hands-on Scrum Master experience managing sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog
refinement, sprint reviews, retrospectives, impediment resolution, and coordinating delivery
across BA, development and QA teams.
Hands-on US Healthcare application experience working with payer/provider workflows, claims processing, enrollment and eligibility, including analysis and validation of healthcare application requirements and EDI 834/835/837 transactions.
Tracked velocity, burndown/burnup and sprint health, maintained Azure DevOps/Jira
artifacts, facilitated continuous improvement and ensured successful delivery of RCM
enhancements.
Business Analyst Cum Scrum Master | Sygnius Infotech
Feb 2021 - Dec 2024
Project: US Healthcare Provider Credentialing & Network Management Platform
Client: Verisys
Project Overview
Worked on a healthcare payer platform for provider onboarding, credentialing, network participation
and provider lifecycle management. The platform streamlined provider data collection, credential
verification, network enrollment, contract management and ongoing provider maintenance.
Responsibilities:
Conducted stakeholder workshops and requirement discussions with business, Operations,
Provider, Member Services and Compliance teams to understand healthcare workflows and
define business requirements.
Hands-on experience with HL7 healthcare integration, working with HL7 messages/interfaces
to support secure and accurate exchange of clinical and administrative healthcare data
between payer, provider, EHR/EMR, and other healthcare applications. Involved in
understanding interface requirements, validating message formats/data, analyzing integration
issues, and coordinating with technical teams to ensure successful end-to-end healthcare data
flow.
Analyzed current-state processes, business pain points and functional gaps, and designed
future-state workflows to improve operational efficiency and claims processing.
Translated requirements into epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, functional
specifications and process flows, ensuring requirements were clear and testable.
Worked with Product Owners, architects, developers and QA teams to evaluate solution
options, system integrations, business rules and data requirements.
• Managed and prioritized the product backlog, supporting requirement decomposition, story
refinement, dependency identification and sprint readiness.
Facilitated Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Backlog Refinement, Sprint Reviews and
Retrospectives, ensuring effective Scrum adoption and delivery cadence.
Coordinated with cross-functional teams to manage risks, blockers, impediments,
dependencies and action items, proactively resolving issues affecting sprint commitments.
Supported UAT planning and execution, including business scenario validation, defect triage,
requirement clarification, retesting and stakeholder sign-off.
Coordinated release planning, production readiness and deployment activities, ensuring scope,
documentation and business validation were completed before release.
Monitored sprint velocity, burndown, delivery progress and team capacity, communicated
status and risks to stakeholders, and drove continuous improvement through retrospective
actions.
Functional Test Engineer | Infiride Technologies Ltd
Oct 2015 - Feb 2021
Responsibilities:
Create detailed test cases based on business and functional requirements.
Execute functional, regression, and integration test cases to ensure application behavior
matches requirements.

Identify, document, and report defects using defect management tools (e.g., JIRA).
Maintain clear and thorough documentation of test cases, test results, and defect reports.
Perform regression testing to ensure new changes do not negatively impact existing
functionality.
Work closely with developers to reproduce issues and verify fixes.
Collaborate with business analysts and product managers to review functional requirements
and provide feedback.
Verify the functionality and usability of the application’s user interface.
Configure and set up test environments that simulate real-world scenarios.
Perform testing across different platforms (e.g., web, mobile) and browsers to ensure
consistent functionality.
Provide regular updates on test progress, results, and any issues identified during testing.
